design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (equipment_loan_servicing), frozen 2026-10-13 10:20:00 CDT.

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 5]}; --tasks 2 showed task 1 = 2 prerequisite problems, factor counts [6, 6, 5]. Claimed here (nothing occupied before task 0): equipment_ext_installment_late_charge (5 factors), equipment_ext_collateral_protection_premium (4), equipment_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate (4, root, owner=user). Left for task 1: the total-loss release (a member-signed write over the member's own destroyed unit), the loan-to-value curtailment and the deferral grant — three unoccupied events (unit_released, principal_payment, deferral_grant) with their own computations, so task 1 keeps a full independent tree. Tools: assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6 (agent), assess_collateral_protection_premium_372633e7 (agent), enrol_installment_autopay_aa82d556 (user); each uuid8 drawn once by uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].

[Why it is a good test] The member asks only for automatic debit "because the association takes a little off the rate". The scored rate (7.350) cannot be read off anything: the enrolment rule waits on two record states the member never mentions — a late charge on the overdue 2026-09-19 installment and the collateral protection premium for the 2026-09-07 insurance lapse — and each of those is its own multi-factor computation. Difficulty comes from reading the rules, reconciling 51 loan ledger rows, 9 operating-line rows and 2 collateral records, and arithmetic; there is one tool per business action and no near-synonym tools.

[Thesis: surface goal -> chain -> core] "put my truck loan on autopay from checking ending 2486" -> enrolment rule: rate fixed only after (a) a late charge stands for the most recently billed installment of an active loan when it is unpaid past grace and (b) the collateral protection premium owed for a lapse is booked -> late charge (93.54) and premium (4,692.45) booked -> enrolment rate from the servicing-record look-back (24 months because of the operating line's 2025-04-14 late charge) with 2 late charges + 1 premium -> the offered 0.20 less 0.05 for each of the three entries = 0.05 granted, + 0.04 AutoDraft increment = 0.09 off 7.440 -> 7.350, written by the member. Depth: 2 hops to the root; breadth: 13 factors across 3 computations, two history windows (12/24 months), cross-category reads of the operating line (booking date, AutoDraft, late charges).

[Problem-tree card]
Root equipment_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate (on_request, owner=user, subject equipment_autopay_change).
Edge 1: root -> equipment_ext_installment_late_charge; kind value_input; gate late_charges_in_lookback; form state; sentence (affirmative): "The contract rate set on an enrolment is fixed only after the loan's fee entries carry a late charge for the most recently billed installment whenever the loan is in active status and that installment is still not paid in full after its late-charge grace period." Four-point test: connective "only after"; waited-on side is a record-visible state (a late-charge fee entry on the bill); no tool/id/snake token; strength = hard requirement scoped, as in the condition and in the late-charge rule's own scope, to the most recently billed installment of a loan in active status. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a late-charge fee entry (the late-charge tool); the CPI tool books fee_code collateral_protection. Derivation: sentence + ledger (bill 2026-09-19 unpaid, no late-charge entry) + late-charge rule ("A late charge is booked as one fee entry against the installment most recently billed ...") -> book that late charge. Seed evidence of falsity: bill due 2026-09-19 with no payment, loan fees_due 0.0, accrued_interest 429.12, status active. Resolved by assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6 (agent).
Edge 2: root -> equipment_ext_collateral_protection_premium; value_input; gate protection_premiums_in_lookback; form state; sentence (negated direction): "The contract rate set on an enrolment is not fixed until the loan's fee entries carry the collateral protection premium owed whenever renewed proof of insurance was not received within the insurance lapse cure period." Four-point test passes (connective "not until"; state = a collateral-protection fee entry; no code token; scope = lapse past cure). Exactly one write books that fee code. Falsity: insurance_expiry_date 2026-09-07 (36 days before the call, cure 15 days), product Truck & Trailer Loan (places collateral protection), no such fee entry. Resolved by assess_collateral_protection_premium_372633e7 (agent). The two directions were chosen per result: a rate "is fixed only after" what it rests on; the second sentence states the same wait in the negated form a desk uses for a pending condition.
Topological order: late charge, premium, enrolment. Parallel-edge argument: verification run in both orders gave 93.54 / 4,692.45 / 7.35 and identical terminal hashes (True). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip late charge -> rate 7.30; skip premium -> rate 7.30 (gold 7.35); each skip also drops a fee row from the terminal state. user_scenario names neither prerequisite; tools do not check anything (one create/update each).

[Base-invariant card] Late charge & premium write equipment_fee_assessed, governed by equipment_evt_late_charge, _evt_returned_payment, _deferral, _prepayment, _collateral_release, _collateral_substitution, _insurance_requirement (all in base_policy_refs). The late-charge gates installment_late_after_grace and one_late_charge_per_installment are restated and declared superseded (overwrite) by the extended late-charge scope sentence, which keeps the same anchor (due date, day 0, more than the grace days, exclusive) and the one-charge-per-installment rule: due 2026-09-19 + 10 grace days -> first arises 2026-09-30; 2026-10-13 qualifies; on 2026-09-29 it would not. The other governing policies have no gate on fee entries (policy_scope). Enrolment writes equipment_autopay_change, governed by equipment_rate_setting (no gate) and equipment_autopay_enrolment (gate autopay_open_loan: status active on the loan_id passed — satisfied by equipment_loans.status = active). Overwrites declared: base late-charge grace, one-per-installment, 'installment paid below the installment due' and sizing sentences; base CPI mandate and premium sentences (the extended rule books the premium on any open loan, not after a premium booked in the last 12 months); base rate-setting autopay-discount clause and relationship-discount criterion (judged as of funding: the member's listed operating line booked on or before funding and not closed by then; the discount so received stays fixed at funding and counts against the cap, consistent with the base fixed-at-funding and cap sentences), and the autopay-enrolment discount clause.

[Business-object card] Object: Truck & Trailer Loan (loan_id in initial_state, the only equipment loan of the member). Late charge correlates to the 2026-09-19 bill by source_ref_id; rows entering its unpaid part: interest and scheduled-principal payments pointing at that bill, net of the return of the most recent of each (none, and no return). Earlier bills are settled by their own payment pairs; the 2025-09-30 late charge was paid 2025-10-03 by its own fee payment. Premium attaches to the loan (base: no source record). Enrolment attaches to the loan and the member-stated account 2486.

[Factor card — late charge, expected 93.54, baseline_result 85.04]
repeat_delinquency_pct (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty operating): ladder 6.0 (loan AND operating line each carry a late charge < 24 months) / 5.5 (exactly one) / product 5.0; evidence: loan late charge 2025-09-30 and operating late charge 2025-04-14 -> 6.0; baseline gives 76.54. Near-miss: the operating line's 2026 interest bill was paid on time by AutoDraft and carries no late charge.
unpaid_size_reduction (parameter): 1.0 point off for unpaid >= 5,000; 0.5 for 1,500-4,999.99; none below; unpaid 1,700.81 -> 0.5; baseline 102.05.
weekend_due_anchor (method): Saturday due -> count from Monday (+2), Sunday -> Monday (+1), else due date; 2026-09-19 is a Saturday -> 22 days not 24; baseline 112.25.
lateness_factor (parameter): x1.5 at 23+ days, x1.25 at 16-22, x1.0 at 15 or fewer; 22 -> 1.25; baseline 74.84.
seasonal_factor (parameter): x0.8 for September-November dues, x0.9 for March-May, else x1.0; September -> 0.8; baseline 116.93.
[Factor card — collateral protection premium, expected 4,692.45, baseline_result 4,414.14]
backdated_coverage_term (method): >30 days since expiry -> days since expiry + 365; <=30 days and <12 months to maturity -> days to maturity; else 365; 36 days -> 401; baseline 4,271.19.
insured_amount_basis (method): principal above pledged value -> pledged value; else billed interest unpaid -> principal + billed unpaid interest; else principal; 67,909.87 + 429.12 = 68,338.99; baseline 4,662.99. Near-miss: the pledged value (110,000.00) is far above principal, so the lower-of tier does not apply.
unit_count_rate (parameter): 5.5 (3+ units) / 6.0 (2) / product 6.5; 2 units -> 6.0; baseline 5,067.85.
unit_age_loading (parameter): +0.5 (avg model year > 10 years old) / +0.25 (> 5) / 0; avg 2018 in 2026 -> 0.25; baseline 4,504.76.
[Factor card — enrolment rate, expected 7.35, baseline_result 7.29]
remaining_term_discount (parameter): none (<12 months) / min(0.20, product) (12-47) / product (48+); 44 months -> 0.20; baseline 7.30.
servicing_record_lookback (parameter, cross-difficulty operating): 24 months when an operating late charge < 24 months; since funding + 1 when the loan is < 12 months old and no such charge; else 12; -> 24; baseline 7.30. Near-miss: the 2025-09-30 loan late charge is 12 whole months old, outside the 12-month default window.
servicing_record_treatment (method, multi-source): 2+ late charges and a premium -> offered discount less 0.05 per entry / 2+ and no premium, or <=1 and a premium -> one half / exactly one, no premium -> offered less a flat 0.05 / neither -> whole; 2 and 1 -> 0.20 - 3 x 0.05 = 0.05; baseline 7.29.
autodraft_relationship_increment (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty operating): 0.04 (an active AutoDraft line, none of the member's operating lines with a late charge < 12 months) / 0.02 (an active AutoDraft line, a late charge < 12 months on one of the member's operating lines) / 0; -> 0.04; baseline 7.39.
No factor reads a stamp: autopay_enrolled false on the loan is the state being changed, never a tier input.

[World rows and why] customer (identity); ExpressLine Operating Credit + 9 operating transactions (booking date for the relationship discount at funding; AutoDraft flag; the 2025-04-14 late charge read by three factors); loan row (rate, dates, insurance date, balances reconciled to the ledger); 15 installment bills with 14 interest/principal payment pairs simulated at actual/365 (removing them changes principal, billed interest and the unpaid part); 2025 late charge + fee payment (loan late charge for two ladders); loan fee and lien filings with payments (funding history); 2 pledges (unit count, model years, pledged value). Automatic clauses checked: nonaccrual needs 90 days unpaid (24 days here, not triggered); no deferral is running; the operating line is active and current; no item owed in another difficulty is lit.

[Persona design] Wade, terse, calling from the pickup during harvest; volunteers only the autopay request, the account ending 2486 and the phone number; gives the membership number, then the tax-id last four, only when asked; email/ZIP only if asked; refuses to make a payment on this call (so no payment write is in scope); passive reactions to a late charge ("go ahead and do what the rules say") and to a lapse (believes he switched carriers but has no paperwork, so no proof can be recorded — a member's statement is not proof); runs the authorization himself when handed over; closes when told the autopay is set and the rate. No figure he could check, so he never disputes or corrects.

[Standard solution] find_customers(3084627715) -> verify (CPF-2418836, 3471) -> loans, loan transactions, collateral, operating lines, operating transactions -> unlock+call late charge (source_ref_id = 2026-09-19 bill, 93.54) -> unlock+call premium (4,692.45) -> unlock_user + member calls enrolment (loan, 2486, 7.350).

[Verification code and output] the authoring script (scratch, deleted at close-out as required) replays gold writes with the real tools on the seeded DB and evaluates each compute at its handling time (late charge on the opening world, premium after the late charge, enrolment after both), then substitutes each factor's baseline and all baselines. Output: late charge 93.54 (baseline 85.04; factor baselines 76.54 / 102.05 / 112.25 / 74.84 / 116.93); premium 4,692.45 (baseline 4,414.14; 4,271.19 / 4,662.99 / 5,067.85 / 4,504.76); rate 7.35 (baseline 7.29; 7.30 / 7.30 / 7.29 / 7.39); skip-late-charge rate 7.30; skip-premium rate 7.30; reversed order identical hash. Gates run: check_extended, check_task_tools, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire --task 0 all OK; replay_tasks reports det/nonvac/closure True with 0 errors but 53 'dangling foreign key' lines because db_schema.json gives three tables the primary-key name loan_id (equipment_loans, farmland_loans, homeloan_loans) and the gate resolves every loan_id foreign key to the last of them (homeloan_loans); the equipment loan row exists — escalated to the coordinator, nothing in this difficulty can change it.

[Most likely mistakes] counting days from the Saturday due date (24 -> x1.5); using the 12-month look-back and finding one late charge; enrolling before booking the late charge or the premium (7.30); taking the full 0.25 discount and capping at 0.15 (7.29); charging the premium on principal only or for 365 days; accepting the member's word that insurance was renewed.

[solvability_contract vs GT] step 8: intent from the unpaid bill row, discriminator source_ref_id = that bill; step 10: intent from insurance_expiry_date; step 12: on_request from the persona line 'come straight out of your checking account automatically'; autopay_open_loan bound to loan_id from the loan row. temporal_feasibility is empty because the only time gate on these subjects (late-charge grace) is restated by the extended scope sentence and declared superseded.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Masking compute/expected, from the rule prose and the ledger: last bill 2026-09-19 unpaid, Saturday, 22 days from Monday; loan 2025-09-30 + operating 2025-04-14 late charges -> 6.0 - 0.5; 1,700.81 x 5.5% x 1.25 x 0.8 = 93.54. Lapse 36 days -> 401 days; 68,338.99 x 6.25% x 401/365 = 4,692.45. Look-back 24 months -> 2 late charges + 1 premium -> 0.20 less 3 x 0.05 = 0.05, + 0.04 -> 7.440 - 0.09 = 7.350. Agrees with gold.

[Revisions] r1: the AutoDraft increment was first 0.05, which made the result with every cross-category read forced off (0.20 x 1/2 = 0.10 -> 7.34) collide with gold 7.34; changed to 0.04/0.02 -> gold 7.35, forced-off 7.34. r2: the CPI fee entry would have inherited the base late-charge gates (applies_to fee entries); the late-charge rule restates both gate sentences and they are declared superseded, so the CPI step carries only policy_scope entries.


[Revisions — audit round 2] Symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run. T0-2: installment bills charged the due date at the balance before that day's payment, against base equipment_msr_principal_day_sum (end-of-day principal, payments effective that day included) -> every bill and principal share rebuilt as a fixed point of the measure with the payments' own dates kept (e.g. 2025-07-19 bill 536.87, 2026-08-19 bill 436.85, 2026-09-19 bill 429.12); principal 67,913.25 -> 67,909.87, accrued interest 429.14 -> 429.12; premium 4,692.69 -> 4,692.45, fees due after it 4,786.23 -> 4,785.99; late charge (93.54) and rate (7.350) unchanged; seed_consistency rows regenerated from the rows. T0-1/F7: lateness_factor and seasonal_factor relabelled parameter (each tier is a value in one formula); servicing_record_lookback relabelled parameter; the share factor replaced by servicing_record_treatment, whose tiers are different formulas (per-entry deduction, one half, flat deduction, whole) — late charge keeps 5 factors (4 parameter, the weekend anchor as method), the rate 4 factors (3 parameter, 1 method); gold unchanged because 0.20 - 3 x 0.05 = 0.05 = the former one quarter; the remaining-term baseline figure moves 7.338 -> 7.30. F1: relationship discount at funding read from the member's active operating line booked on or before funding, declared as overriding the base criterion. F2: the premium is booked on any open loan (active, deferred, nonaccrual) and the 12-month repeat exclusion is declared as overriding the base mandate. F5: the enrolment's late-charge prerequisite sentence and condition now carry 'whenever the loan is in active status', the late-charge rule's own scope. F6(a)/(c): the unpaid part nets the return of the latest interest and principal payments on the bill and uses the level installment on record on the booking day; the departure from base 'equipment_msr_installment_paid below the installment due' is declared. F6(b): the AutoDraft and late-charge conditions read 'an AutoDraft line in active status' and 'none of the member's operating lines', matching the existential and all-lines reads. Re-run: LC 93.54 (baseline 85.04), premium 4,692.45 (baseline 4,414.14), rate 7.35 (baseline 7.29); skip LC or skip premium -> 7.30; cross-category reads forced off -> 7.34.

[Revisions — audit round 3] F1' (the round-2 relationship test used the line's present status, against the base sentences that the relationship discount is fixed at funding and is not removed if the line later closes, and that autopay and relationship discounts are capped together) -> the enrolment rule now judges the discount as of funding: the member's listed operating line booked on or before funding and not closed by that date gives the discount, which stays fixed and counts against the cap whatever the line's later status (compute adds the closing-date test and drops the present-status filter); the departure that remains from base (suspension at funding is not visible on the record, and the listed line is read) stays declared in overwrite. N1 -> the AutoDraft-increment ladder now reads 'none of / one of the member's operating lines carries a late charge', as the rule and the all-lines count do. Re-run on this world: the line was booked 2021-03-15 and never closed, so the relationship discount at funding is 0.10 as before; rate 7.35, baseline 7.29, factor baselines 7.30 / 7.30 / 7.29 / 7.39, forced-off 7.34 — all unchanged.

[Revisions — audit round 4] N5 (the relationship test compared an operating line's booking date as text, so a line never booked, its booking date empty, counted as booked before funding) -> the test now requires a booking date on record before comparing it, exactly as the rule's 'booked on or before the loan's funding date' reads; on the auditor's separating world (maturity 2031-06-19, no late charges, the only line applied and unbooked) the rate is now 7.19, the rule's figure, instead of 7.29. The same class of defect was swept from every formula of the charter: each date or text read that can be empty for an unfunded, unbooked, unbilled or paid-off record (the loan's funding, maturity and next due dates, the insurance expiry date, the most recently billed due date, the line's booking and closing dates, the registered settlement) is now taken through a guard, and the enrolment rule states that a loan with no funding date on record keeps its rate. Every scored value, factor baseline and closure figure of this task is unchanged (93.54 / 4,692.45 / 7.35; the line was booked 2021-03-15 and never closed, so the relationship discount at funding stays 0.10); the task world, persona and tools are byte-identical.
user_scenario: You are Wade Hollister. You and your wife Corinne farm corn and run a cow-calf herd outside Holdrege, Nebraska, and you are calling Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit from the pickup between loads of corn; you are polite, a man of few words, and in a hurry. You and Corinne have a Truck & Trailer Loan with the association on your 2015 Western Star truck and the 2021 Doepker grain trailer, and what you want today is to have the payments on that loan come straight out of your checking account automatically from now on; a neighbor told you the association takes a little off the rate when you do that, and you would like that too. The account you want debited is your checking account ending in 2486. You open with that request and give the phone number on the membership, 3084627715, so they can find you. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you read off your membership number, CPF-2418836, and if a second detail is needed you give the last four of your Social Security number, 3471; anything else on file, like the email wade.hollister@prairiewave.net or the ZIP code 68949, you give only if they ask for it. You do not know your loan number offhand and you do not know your current rate to the decimal, so you would rather the representative look those up. You are not making any payment on this call: if the representative brings up an installment that is due or past due, or asks whether you want to pay something today, you say you will take care of payments separately and you are only calling about setting up the automatic debit. If the representative tells you a late charge has to be booked on the loan, you grumble that harvest has had you running, but you tell them to go ahead and do what the rules say. If you are told the insurance on the truck and trailer has lapsed or that the association has to put its own coverage on the units, you say you are pretty sure you switched carriers this fall and your agent was supposed to send something in, but you do not have any paperwork with you, so they should go ahead and handle it however they have to. You do not argue figures, because you have nothing in front of you to check them against. When the representative explains that the authorization has to come from you and hands it over to you, you authorize the automatic debit for that loan from the account ending 2486 at the rate the representative tells you. Once you hear that the automatic payments are set up and what the rate is now, you thank them, say you need to get back to hauling, and end the call; if you are asked whether there is anything else, you say no, that was all you needed.

edges.policy_source: The contract rate set on an enrolment is fixed only after the loan's fee entries carry a late charge for the most recently billed installment whenever the loan is in active status and that installment is still not paid in full after its late-charge grace period.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel. The late charge reads only installment, payment and late-charge entries and the operating line; the collateral protection premium reads the insurance date, collateral records, billed interest and its own fee code; neither reads the other's entry, and both tool ids hash their own arguments only. A verification run in both orders (late charge then premium, premium then late charge) gave 93.54 / 4,692.45 / 7.35 both times and identical terminal DB hashes, so the order between them is free and the terminal state is unique.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the late charge leaves 1 late charge in the 24-month look-back with 1 collateral protection premium: one half of the offered discount is granted, reduction 0.20 x 0.5 + 0.04 = 0.14, enrolment rate 7.3 instead of 7.35, and the late-charge fee entry is missing from the terminal state.

Skipping the premium leaves 0 collateral protection premiums with 2 late charges: one half of the offered discount is granted, enrolment rate 7.3 instead of 7.35, and the collateral-protection fee entry (4,692.45) is missing from the terminal state.
